actionConfiguration.body:
UPDATE Sensor
SET
  Calibration = {{ Number(CalibrationWiring.correctionValue()) }},
  LastCalib   = STR_TO_DATE('{{ moment().format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") }}','%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
  Due         = DATE(STR_TO_DATE('{{ CalibrationWiring.nextCalText() }}','%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'))
WHERE ID = {{ Number(CalibrationWiring.hwId()) }};
